selection: Highest validation top1 across epochs 0..209; earliest epoch on ties. model_best.pth.tar only.
primary_contrast: Paired B minus A0 internal-test top1 percentage points, separately by depth
precision: FP32; TF32 and cuDNN benchmark disabled; same frozen model, optimizer and schedule as preceding protocol
historical_limitations: This is a frozen-protocol internal holdout replication after exploratory development. All 50000 source examples have been used in historical training, and official-test feedback influenced earlier design. Resplitting does not erase this history or create a wholly independent confirmation. Do not pool old or cancelled runs with new results.
